purpose: Generate and independently validate the first and second perturbative directional coefficients L_m[V] and Q_m[V,V] of the already certified minimally coupled pressureless-matter action in the same scalar-longitudinal plane-symmetric 3+1 geometry used by GE06.

frozen_action.covariant: S_d=-1/2 int sqrt(-g) rho_phys (g^munu d_mu T d_nu T + 1)

target_blocks.first_directional: L_m[V] = first epsilon derivative at epsilon=0 of every dust Euler-Lagrange source
target_blocks.second_directional: Q_m[V,V] = second epsilon derivative at epsilon=0 along the same direction

deterministic_audit.perturbation_direction: fixed smooth multi-harmonic perturbations in N,L,R,b,T,varrho

classification_rule.pass: all exact and numerical gates pass -> GE07_PRESSURELESS_MATTER_DIRECTIONAL_SOURCE_GENERATOR_PASS

claim_boundary: PASS certifies the pressureless-matter L/Q directional source generator needed for the H3/H4 scalar hierarchy. It does not solve Z20/Z21, add radiation/baryon-pressure/neutrino nonlinearities, introduce finite eta, or make collapse/observational claims.
anti_tuning: Do not change the dust action, background, audit direction, grid sizes, finite-difference steps, source list, or thresholds after inspecting GE07 output.
